- Preparing a removed outer trim.

1. A removed outer trim may be reused only if it was not damaged during removal.

2. Using suitable equipment cut and level the bead of sealant on the outer trim so that it is as thin as possible.

The remaining sealant does not have to be removed completely.

3. Clean the perimeter of the serigraphed area of the outer trim thoroughly with compressed air and degrease it using heptane.

Check that the outer trim is not damaged.
